attribution: Menne, Matthew J., et al. (2023). Global Historical Climatology Network-Hourly (GHCNh). NOAA NCEI. Subset: POMU0068545, six reports in January 2010; accessed 2026-10-31. https://doi.org/10.25921/jp3d-3v19. Selected rows; no NOAA endorsement.

fixture.transformation: Header and six complete source lines copied byte-for-byte, in source order. No fields rewritten; original LF endings retained. Curated examples, not a contiguous time series.

station_fixture.transformation: One complete station-list line copied byte-for-byte.

semantics.timestamp_timezone: UTC, explicitly documented despite offset-free DATE strings
semantics.missing: Empty precipitation cells; never replace with zero.
semantics.trace: Measurement code T with value 0.0 is a trace, not an observed dry interval.
semantics.quality: Blank source QC codes do not establish passed QC.
semantics.overlap: Do not combine overlapping 6-hour and 12-hour totals or invent sub-hourly observations.

interpretation: Historical rainfall ingestion examples only. No river-level observations, flood labels, accuracy scores or evidence of a flood event.
